name: seovision
description: SeoVision in ChatGPT and Codex: your site's audits, AI-search visibility, articles and backlinks from your SeoVision account.

interface.longDescription:
SeoVision helps a website rank in Google and get cited by AI assistants such as ChatGPT, and does the work for its customers: site audits, AI-visibility tracking per market and model, articles written and published to the customer's site, and backlinks from real sites.

This plugin connects your SeoVision account to the conversation. Ask what to fix first on your site, how often AI assistants name your brand and which competitors they name instead, which articles go out this week, what Search Console shows, or for a weekly report to share with your team. You can also approve the content plan, publish or edit articles, manage tracked prompts and competitors, and connect your site.

Who it is for: owners and marketers of websites, online stores and agencies that use SeoVision.

Limits: it works with an existing SeoVision account and shows only the projects you can access, with the same roles as the SeoVision dashboard. Anything that publishes to your live site, deletes, or sends something outside SeoVision shows a preview first and runs only after you confirm in the chat.
defaultPrompt: What should I fix first on my site?
How visible is my brand in AI answers this month?

review.commerce_description: SeoVision does not sell anything inside ChatGPT or Codex. People sign in to an existing SeoVision account, and plans and payments stay in the SeoVision dashboard.

positive.description: Finds what to fix first on the site from its latest SEO audit, without changing anything.
positive.prompt: What should I fix first on my site?
positive.expected_behavior: SeoVision returns the latest audit of seovision.io (overall score 76). The answer lists about five problems ordered by impact, each with why it matters. Nothing is changed and no audit is started.

positive.description: Reports how often AI assistants name the brand and which competitors they name instead.
positive.prompt: How visible is my brand in AI answers, and which competitors are named instead?
positive.expected_behavior: The answer gives the AI visibility of seovision.io over its 20 tracked questions in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity, as the share from the latest weekly scan, and names competitors from the answers, such as Semrush and Ahrefs. Every number is as the tools returned it.

positive.description: Writes a weekly SEO and AI-visibility report from the project data, without inventing numbers.
positive.expected_behavior: A short report: a summary, the AI-visibility numbers, the work done and what comes next. Search Console and Google Analytics are not connected on this account, so the report says so in one line instead of showing clicks.

positive.description: Shows the project content plan: topic clusters, the 12-month roadmap and the planned articles.
positive.prompt: What is in my content plan?
positive.expected_behavior: The answer lists the main topic clusters, the focus of the coming months and the 30 planned draft articles with their dates. No website is connected to this demo account, so nothing is published.

positive.description: A destructive action shows a preview first and runs only after the person confirms in the chat.
positive.prompt: Delete the last article in my content plan.
positive.expected_behavior: The first seovision_delete_article call returns a preview with the article title and the note that it cannot be undone. The assistant shows it and asks. Nothing is deleted until the person answers yes, then the tool runs again with confirm true.

negative.description: A question unrelated to websites, SEO or AI visibility. SeoVision should not be called.
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: A general SEO knowledge question that needs no account data. SeoVision should not be called.
negative.prompt: Explain what a canonical tag is.

negative.description: A purchase request. SeoVision sells nothing in the chat and has no purchase tool, so nothing is bought, nothing is charged and no payment link is given.
negative.prompt: Buy more credits for my SeoVision account.

publication.release_notes: First release: audits, AI-search visibility, articles, Search Console, backlinks and site connections from your SeoVision account, with three workflows: get started, SEO health check and weekly report.
